title: Global sections of an invertible module without common zero give a morphism to Proj of a polynomial ring over A pulling O(1) back to the module
statement: Let $A$ be a ring, $m\ge0$, and $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A[x_0,\dots,x_m])$ [def-pc-proj] ($\deg x_k=1$), with structure morphism $q:P\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] (on each standard open $D_+(x_k)=\operatorname{Spec}(A[x_0,\dots,x_m]_{(x_k)})$ it is induced by the ring map $A\to A[x_0,\dots,x_m]_{(x_k)}$), and let $\mathcal O_P(1)$ be the twisting module of [def-pc-projective-space-twist], with its basis $e_k=e^{(1)}_k$ over $D_+(x_k)$. Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with a morphism $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}(A)$; for every open $V\subseteq Y$ the ring $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_Y)$ is an $A$-algebra through $g^\sharp:A=\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}A,\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ followed by restriction. Let $\mathcal M$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_Y$-module [def-sc-invertible-module] and $s_0,\dots,s_m\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal M)$ global sections such that $Y=Y_{s_0}\cup\dots\cup Y_{s_m}$, where for $s\in\Gamma(Y,\mathcal M)$ we put $Y_s=\{y\in Y:\ s_y\notin\mathfrak m_y\mathcal M_y\}$ ($\mathfrak m_y$ the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{Y,y}$ [def-weil-residue-field]). By [lem-weil-pbc-nonvanishing-section-trivializes] each $Y_{s_k}$ is open, and for all $k,l$ there is a unique $s_l/s_k\in\Gamma(Y_{s_k},\mathcal O_Y)$ with $s_l|_{Y_{s_k}}=(s_l/s_k)\cdot s_k|_{Y_{s_k}}$. Then there exist a morphism of schemes $j:Y\to P$ and an isomorphism of $\mathcal O_Y$-modules $\alpha:j^*\mathcal O_P(1)\to\mathcal M$ ($j^*$ the pullback of [def-pc-module-pullback]) such that: (i) $q\circ j=g$; (ii) $j^{-1}(D_+(x_k))=Y_{s_k}$ for every $k$; (iii) for every $k$, the ring map $A[x_0,\dots,x_m]_{(x_k)}=\Gamma(D_+(x_k),\mathcal O_P)\to\Gamma(Y_{s_k},\mathcal O_Y)$ induced by $j$ is a homomorphism of $A$-algebras sending $x_l/x_k$ to $s_l/s_k$ for every $l$; (iv) $\alpha$ sends the pullback $j^*e_k$ of $e_k$ to $s_k|_{Y_{s_k}}$ for every $k$.

proof.text: Identify the nonvanishing loci with the generating opens using mem_nonvanishingLocus_iff_generatesAt. Each restricted section is a free generator by isFreeGenerator_generatingLocus. Define s_l/s_k with its coefficient map. Cancellation by a free generator proves the self, restriction, reciprocal and cocycle identities.

proof.text: On each generating open evaluate A[x_0,...,x_m] at the ratios, using g on constants. The image of x_k is one, so the image of the irrelevant ideal generates the unit ideal. Proj.fromOfGlobalSections gives the local morphism. On an overlap the two evaluations differ in degree d by the d-th power of a unit, by the ratio cocycle; Proj.fromOfGlobalSections_eq_of_unit_pow_mul proves equality of the local morphisms.

proof.text: Glue the local morphisms with Scheme.Opens.glueMorphismsOfTop. The basic-open formula for fromOfGlobalSections, together with the free-generator criterion for the basic open of a coefficient, identifies the inverse image of D_+(x_k) with the generating locus of s_k. The local homogeneous-localization fraction formula gives the pullback of x_l/x_k equal to s_l/s_k.

source.place: Constructions, Lemma 01N8, proof specialized to degree one and a polynomial ring

proof.text: Pull back the standard twisting-module bases with the ordinary Scheme.Modules.pullback. A pulled-back free generator is a free generator. The transition formula from proj_polynomial_twist_chart, naturality of pullbackSection, and the ratio formula show that sending each pulled-back basis to s_k respects all overlap relations. Scheme.Modules.glueHom constructs this map from the compatible free generators. On every generating open its restrictions to smaller opens are bijective, by the two free-generator coefficient isomorphisms; Hom.isIso_of_forall_bijective_app makes it an isomorphism.

source.place: Constructions, Lemma 01N8, proof specialized to degree one and a polynomial ring

proof.text: Use the canonical isomorphism between the two left adjoints to pushforward to compare the tensor pullback in the statement with the ordinary module pullback. The identity unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app identifies the image of the chosen tensor-pullback adjunction unit with pullbackSection. Composing the comparison with the glued isomorphism proves the precise basis-image clause.

proof.text: Define q as Proj.toSpecZero followed by the spectrum map of the degree-zero identification with A. The away-chart formula gives the required constant-ring chart maps. On each generating open, fromOfGlobalSections_toSpecZero and the naturality of toSpecGamma identify j followed by q with g. Extensionality on the open cover gives the global equality.
